# Massive XSS Payloads Master Dataset

> Consolidated from uploaded XSS payload repositories and cheat sheets.

This is a large, inherited research index. Search it by browser context, event name, element, encoding, or sink rather than reading it linearly. Payload presence is not evidence of exploitability: use the smallest context-specific probe in an authorized target or owned lab, apply a negative control, and record the exact parser/sink behavior. Original item-level licensing and provenance are not available, so do not republish this collection as a standalone payload corpus.

---

## Sections

- Basic Payloads
- DOM XSS
- Encoding / Obfuscation
- Event Handlers
- Misc Payloads
- Polyglots
- Remote Script Includes
- SVG Payloads
